fun_facts: Trevor Lawrence was born in Cartersville, Georgia.
At Cartersville High, Trevor Lawrence helped his team win two state championships as a starter.
As a true freshman at Clemson, Trevor Lawrence helped the Tigers win the national championship.
At Clemson, Trevor Lawrence’s teams went 34–2 in his starts, and he threw 90 career passing touchdowns.
At Cartersville High, Trevor Lawrence broke Georgia high-school career records with 13,908 passing yards and 161 touchdown passes.

basis.reasoning: The Jaguars roster biography lists Clemson as Trevor Lawrence’s college.
